spell_check_suggestions_toolbar.name: SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar

theme.note: No theme of its own: the rows and surface resolve the menu component's MenuTheme/MenuPopupTheme.

spinner.description: Indeterminate circular indicator with a rotating arc, widgets-only.
spinner.name: Spinner

stage_container.description: Responsive container that snaps content to breakpoint widths.
stage_container.name: Stage Container

fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - base outer padding; a density-aware value scales with the preset

star_rating.description: Interactive star rating with half-star snapping, keyboard stepping, drag preview and form participation.
star_rating.name: Star Rating

stepper.description: Multi-step flow with numbered indicators and connectors, horizontal or vertical, controlled or controller-driven.
stepper.name: Stepper

fields.connectorColor: ThemedColor? - connector up to the active step
fields.gap: double? - space around the indicator, default 8
fields.pending: StepperIndicatorStyle? - a step after the active one
fields.size: StepperSize? - indicator size, default md (40px circle)
fields.titleStyle: TextStyle? - default is the size typography

steps.description: Vertical numbered step list joined by a connector line.
steps.name: Steps

fields.spacing: double? - gap between indicator column and content

swiper.description: Swipe-to-open wrapper that reveals a drawer or sheet panel.
swiper.name: Swiper

fields.barrierColor: ThemedColor? - barrier colour; null is black at 50%
fields.barrierDismissible: bool? - barrier tap dismisses the panel
fields.behavior: HitTestBehavior? - hit test behaviour of the swipe gesture
fields.borderRadius: BorderRadius? - panel inner-corner radius; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.draggable: bool? - the open panel can be dragged away
fields.expands: bool? - panel fills its slide axis (drawer: false, sheet: true)
fields.maxSize: double? - panel extent along its slide axis; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.showDragHandle: bool? - draw the panel drag handle; null keeps DrawerTheme
fields.threshold: double? - fraction (0..1) of the panel a release must pass to open
fields.useSafeArea: bool? - panel respects the device safe area

switch.description: Boolean form switch with controlled and controller-driven modes, sliding thumb, keyboard activation and form participation.
switch.name: Switch

fields.borderWidth: double? - 0 by default (shadcn draws a transparent one)
fields.labelStyle(row): TextStyle? - colour falls back to foreground
fields.travel: double? - derived from track and thumb at build

switcher.description: Swipeable view that animates between child widgets along a chosen axis.
switcher.name: Switcher

table.description: Themed data grid with span-aware cells, frozen rows/columns, scrolling and optional column/row resizing.
table.name: Table

tabs.description: Pill tab strip with roving arrow-key navigation, plus a sortable IDE-style tab pane over a content card.
tabs.name: Tabs

text_animate.description: Stream-aware animated text renderer for incremental updates, plus a streaming markdown tail.
text_animate.name: TextAnimate

fields.style: TextStyle? - base style, merged over the ambient default

text_area.description: Multi-line text input: an Input with three-line defaults, a multiline keyboard and vertically centred content.
text_area.name: TextArea

theme.reason: A text area has no visual property of its own: every row (fill, border, radius, padding, text, hint, cursor, min height) is `InputTheme`'s, and the widget leg is forwarded verbatim. Adding a second theme class would duplicate those rows and let the two drift apart, so `theme` is null and the shared `InputTheme` is re-exported from text_area.dart instead.

time_picker.description: Clock-time and duration fields opening digit-field sheets (hour/minute/second plus AM/PM, day/hour/minute/second) in a dialog or a popover, wired into the form system.
time_picker.name: TimePicker

fields.dialogTitle: Widget? - title of the dialog prompt; null = none
fields.mode: PromptMode? - dialog or popover presentation; null = dialog

timeline.description: Vertical three-column event timeline: time label, indicator dot with connector, title and content.
timeline.name: Timeline

fields.spacing: double? - null = density base content padding * scaling

timeline_animation.description: Typed keyframe timeline: turns an AnimationController's 0..1 progress into values segment by segment.
timeline_animation.name: Timeline Animation

toast.description: Transient, non-blocking notifications anchored to a screen edge.
toast.name: Toast

fields.offset: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - stack inset from the screen edges
fields.pauseOnHover: bool? - pause the countdown on hover/press

toggle.description: On/off button with a controlled and a controller-driven mode, plus form participation.
toggle.name: Toggle

fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - defaults to px-2 (h8), zero vertical

tooltip.description: Delayed hover label presented through the popover machinery, plus the themed TooltipContainer surface and the tooltip overlay handler.
tooltip.name: Tooltip

fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - null = density base gap at 0.75x
fields.surfaceBlur: double? - null = the app theme's surfaceBlur
fields.textStyle: TextStyle? - its colour is ignored (taken from foreground)

tracker.description: A row of coloured activity segments, each with a hover tooltip.
tracker.name: Tracker

fields.critical: ThemedColor? - fill of a critical segment (destructive token)
fields.fine: ThemedColor? - fill of a fine segment
fields.unknown: ThemedColor? - fill of an unknown segment (mutedForeground token)
fields.warning: ThemedColor? - fill of a warning segment

tree.description: Immutable hierarchical list with expand/collapse, selection and themed indent guides.
tree.name: Tree

fields.itemGap: double? - gap between adornments and content, default 8

constructors: TripleDots({count, direction, size, spacing, color, padding, theme})

triple_dots.description: Row or column of small round dots, used as an ellipsis.
triple_dots.name: TripleDots

window.description: Desktop-style window frame with drag, resize, maximize, close, z-order, focus and edge snapping, hosted by a WindowNavigator.
window.name: Window

fields.resizeThickness: double? - edge grab thickness, 8 by default
fields.snapOverlayBlur: double? - preview backdrop blur, 8 by default
fields.snapOverlayColor: ThemedColor? - snap preview fill, card by default
fields.titleColor: ThemedColor? - title colour, foreground by default
